BOAS surgery for bulldogs

How much does BOAS surgery cost in Los Angeles?

BOAS surgery for an English bulldog in Los Angeles costs between 3,500 and 6,000 US dollars, and that figure normally covers the pre-anaesthetic workup, the airway procedure itself and the first recheck. Dogs that also need laryngeal saccules removed sit at the upper end of that range.

How long does recovery take?

Most bulldogs breathe noticeably better within forty-eight hours and are back to normal activity in fourteen days. Swelling of the soft palate peaks between twenty-four and seventy-two hours, which is why the first two nights are the highest risk period of the whole process.

Soft food for ten days and a harness instead of a collar for two weeks are the two rules owners have to follow.
